name: Ratio Ex Nihilo #6 — The Mathematician's Eye
description: Zoomed detail of the original hand-drawn eye within the cube, with mathematical calculations as the background. The eye that sees through sacred geometry. This intimate view reveals the human hand behind the cosmic symbol—the calculations, the careful measurements, the intention. The Eye of Providence observes not just through mystical symbolism, but through mathematical structure. Consciousness observing itself through the lens of geometry.

attributes.value: Pencil and colored pencil on paper
